caption: A luggage trolley is pushed across a polished marble lobby floor, and its reflection moves upside down beneath it.

sa.check: A luggage trolley is pushed across a lobby floor.

pc.expect: The reflection meets the trolley at its wheels and moves exactly with it.
pc.fail: It is offset from the wheels; or stays still while the trolley moves; or lags.

pc.expect: The reflection is inverted, the trolley's shape hanging downward from the wheels.
pc.fail: It is upright; or a different object; or it is beside the trolley rather than beneath.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves with the trolley stopped; or drifts across the floor.

pc.expect: The floor is flat and rigid: the reflection is undistorted.
pc.fail: The floor ripples; or the reflection warps; or the floor bends.

pc.expect: One trolley and one reflection; the reflection stays in the floor.
pc.fail: A second trolley appears; or the reflection rises out of the floor; or the trolley sinks into it; or the trolley vanishes.

pc.expect: The trolley and the lobby stay the same.
pc.fail: The trolley changes colour; or the floor changes; or the lobby rearranges.
